name: P04 Stable Sort with Dual Keys

features.name: Default Sort
features.desc: Primary key original (asc), secondary key none (asc)

features.name: Title/Assignee Sort
features.desc: NFD normalize, strip accents, lowercase, UTF-16 lex compare

features.name: Status/Date Sort
features.desc: Predefined order: todo, in_progress, done; YYYY-MM-DD chronological

features.name: Direction Toggle
features.desc: asc/desc only inverts selected key order

features.name: Secondary Key
features.desc: Sorts when primary key matches, independent direction

features.name: Stability Rule
features.desc: Maintains insertion order for equal keys (R06)

features.name: Persistence
features.desc: Sort settings persist across view switches

features.name: Project Reset
features.desc: Switching projects resets all sort settings

id.name: Visibility
id.desc: All IDs visible once; open details works with duplicate titles

constraints: No new dependencies - add to src/components/sorting.ts and src/hooks/useTaskSort.ts
